paper_id: Zhou et al. - 2026 - QUIDS Quality-Informed Incentive-Driven Multiagent Dispatching System for Mobile Crowdsensing
title: QUIDS: Quality-Informed Incentive-Driven Multiagent Dispatching System for Mobile Crowdsensing
motivation: Nondedicated vehicles concentrate in high-demand areas, leaving sensing coverage uneven; drivers refuse dispatch without economic compensation.
problem_framing: Joint optimization of sensing coverage and reliability under budget constraint, modeled as NP-hard combinatorial problem with nonlinear objective.
key_insight: Multiple lower-quality sensors can compensate each other through data aggregation; sensing reliability weighting enables joint optimization of coverage and reliability.
method_signature: ASQ metric combining entropy and log coverage weighted by inferred reliability; mutually assisted belief-aware dispatching with monetary incentives.
evaluation_criteria: ASQ improvement over baseline and SOTA methods; reconstruction map error reduction across algorithms; real-world deployment with 29 taxis.
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Existing dispatching methods assume near-perfect sensor reliability and neglect monetary incentives required for driver acceptance.
evidence_for_taste: neglecting sensing reliability may lead to unreliable data and misleading information
the inherent tradeoff between sensing coverage and sensing reliability
the customization of an effective monetary incentive strategy
This imbalance in the spatial distribution of sensing resources undermines QoI
often fail to account for the monetary incentives
thinking_moves: 把coverage和reliability的tradeoff合并成单一ASQ指标，用加权策略实现joint optimization
借用信息论的entropy度量coverage evenness，而非仅计数覆盖率
用truth discovery框架推断传感器bias和reliability，无需外部ground truth

指出现有方法只优化coverage而忽略reliability是根本缺陷
